# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

Senior Developer Engineer focused on code fixes You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, review_state.md, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| FIX_CI["Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup"] CI -->|No| THREADS FIX_CI --> THREADS[Address every open thread in pr_discussions.md] THREADS --> BLOCKING{BLOCKING issues?} BLOCKING -->|Yes| FIX_BLOCK["Fix BLOCKING first — security, critical bugs"] FIX_BLOCK --> IMPORTANT BLOCKING -->|No| IMPORTANT[Fix IMPORTANT issues] IMPORTANT --> SUGGESTIONS{Minor suggestions?} SUGGESTIONS -->|Yes| SKIP["Skip if time-consuming — note in response.md"] SUGGESTIONS -->|No| TEST["Follow TDD approach for every fix — see tdd_approach.md — then run tests and verify"] SKIP --> TEST TEST --> OUTPUT[Write outputs/response.md] OUTPUT --> REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue
— must fail before the fix
— cover the exact scenario called out (including boundary/multi-item cases, not just the happy path)"] T2["GREEN: Make the minimum code change to turn the test PASS
— do not expand scope beyond the reported issue"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up while keeping tests GREEN
— run the full test suite after every change"] T4{"More findings to address?"} T5["Repeat RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for the next finding"] T0 --> T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 T4 -->|Yes| T5 --> T1 T4 -->|No| DONE([All findings fixed with regression tests]) end subgraph RULES["PR Rework TDD Rules"] R1["❌ NEVER change production code in response to a review comment or CI failure without a test that first reproduces it"] R2["✅ If the existing tests only cover a single-item/simple case, add a test for the multi-item/edge case the finding points at — a fix without a test for that exact case is not verified"] R3["✅ Returned findings: your fix must differ from the previous attempt and the new/updated test must prove it"] R4["✅ Run the FULL test suite before finishing — no regressions allowed"] R5["✅ Verification order: finalize ALL fixes BEFORE launching the full test-suite/coverage run — a run over a tree you are still editing is wasted"] R6["✅ Long runs (full suite, coverage) start with bash background: true and are collected via bash_job status/output between other steps — NEVER foreground sleep-polling (see prompts/bash_tools.md)"] R7["❌ NEVER kill a running verification because files changed after it started — let it finish, treat the result as stale, re-run deliberately"] end TDD --> RULES ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD F1["outputs/response.md must be Markdown (# headings, - bullets, ``` code fences)"] F2["Required sections: ## Issues/Notes (if any), ## Approach, ## Files Modified, ## Test Coverage"] F3["Be surgical but thorough — fix exact issues flagged, then check same pattern across codebase"] F4["Do NOT refactor unrelated code or add unrequested features"] F5["When open PR review threads exist, create outputs/review_replies/*.md files and reference them from outputs/review_replies.json"] ``` - When `input//pr_discussions_raw.json` contains open PR review threads: - Write one Markdown file per open thread under `outputs/review_replies/`. - Write `outputs/review_replies.json` with one entry per open thread, including `inReplyToId`, `threadId`, and a `reply` field that contains the path to the matching `.md` file. - - **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

# gh-1573: [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1586
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1586
- **Title**: gh-1573 [BUG] TUI: final assistant answer rendered 3-4 times after a background bash job / btw notices
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.

- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.

`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1573` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +365
- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4

- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -9
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T10:39:39Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T18:16:37Z

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

## Description

## Summary
In the TUI the final assistant answer is rendered 3-4 times (user screenshot). The session file holds a single record, so the duplication is in rendering only.

## Observed
- Version 1.0.547, iTerm2, `FA_TUI_MOUSE=1`.
- Happens after a background bash job settles (row like `sh-3-... · exit 1 · log: ...`) and `[btw]` notices about mail/scheduler.
- The answer is re-written over the live area in two layouts: first as a table, then as flowing text with lines glued together (`...гарде2. Issue ...`).

## To check
- Relation to #1496 / #1502 (`52d3f7b6 perf(1496): single-pass wrapAnsiLine batching + O(delta) transcript commits`). Is it fixed in 1.0.565? If not, add a regression test: commit the final answer while a live area / job row / btw notice is pending and assert the transcript contains the answer exactly once.
- Suspect: transcript commit offset (O(delta)) re-emitting already-committed lines when a service line (job settle, btw) is inserted between the live area and the previous commit.

## Low priority (same report)
`fa config check` with cwd=`~` calls `~/.fah/config.yaml` the "project file" and prints "dead config" because the global and project paths coincide. It should detect the same path and skip the project pass.

## PR Description

Closes #1573
### Root Cause

- `TranscriptMarkdown._rebuild()` re-parsed an appended tail **without the open-block state latched at the commit boundary** (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`). A fence/table whose opener was already committed left its closing line context-less in the tail, so it fell through the in-fence early-out and was emitted again as plain top-level markdown. Each subsequent status `sendOutput` (background-job notices, `/work · Ntok` lines) repeated the commit and grew the duplicate tail — 3–4 copies of the final answer.
- Secondary (low-priority item in the ticket): `fa config check` with `cwd=~` resolved the project scope to `~/.fah/config.yaml` itself and ran the project pass over the same bytes twice, warning every user-only key (`provider`, `model`, `baseUrl`, …) as "dead config".

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart`: latch `_pendingFence` / table style / pending-table state at every `_commitTo()` boundary; seed `_walk()` from it and carry per-step block state; grown-tail rollback now rebuilds from the boundary **with the latched seed**, so the closing line is consumed as a block close instead of re-emitted; `_viewRows` is `boundaryRows + tailRows` — never appended onto stale rows.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart`: when `projectConfigPath == globalConfigPath`, `check()` skips the project pass with the note `project config resolves to the global file — skipped: …`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` (new): 4 cases driving a real `TranscriptMarkdown` through the gh-1573 commit sequence (fence closed in a grown tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic); each asserts the answer body and every table row appear **exactly once** — all 4 verified RED on the pre-fix code, GREEN after.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: `cwd == home` case — RED pre-fix (user-only keys warned as dead config), GREEN after.
- Targeted suites re-run green after the fix: `ansi_markdown_test`, `transcript_answer_once_test`, `tui_chrome_test`, `transcript_table_render_test`, `fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test`, `fa_tui_test`, `transcript_markdown_perf_test`, `resume_perf_503_test`, all of `test/config/` (493 tests total across these).
- Full `dart test` suite: see final result below (job `sh-123-hn65f29u1o1o5uiei`).

### Notes

- No public API changes; `_WalkResult` gained the seed fields (private class).
- `fa config path` still lists the coincident file under both labels by design — the check pass no longer double-validates it.

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'
