with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

with:

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes

    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.

    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0

          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \

      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).

  browser-ext:

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm

    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.

    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0

          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR

    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty

    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are

    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`
  (exit 0; duplication stays a pre-existing soft WARN), loc scope gate (853/853 files within
  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.
  - `test/cli/ansi_markdown_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_table_render_test.dart`,
    `test/config/` — 232 tests passed.
  - `test/cli/tui_chrome_test.dart`, `test/cli/fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_markdown_perf_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for
  `_rollbackGrownTail`), then verified the target methods pass after the split (GREEN: 11.00 /
  5.00, both ≤ 12.00).
- Full `dart test --coverage --exclude-tags integration` (the CI `test-core` unit suite) re-run on
  the final tree: see the job log below; the merged-lcov CRAP measure over it is the same pipeline
  CI's `guards` leg runs.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes

    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # gh-1033 (review thread 7 + gate wiring): the fa jsr delegate suites
      # are integration-tagged (the PTY leg's CLI coverage ratchet measures
      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers
      # (>= 80% ratchet, PR diff-coverage, CRAP — jsr_cli.dart at 0% reads
      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Pub cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: pub-${{ runner.os }}-

      - run: dart pub get
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \
            test-results/junit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml

      # lib/src/cli hits from them), so the sharded unit run above skips
      # them. Their hits must ALSO reach the unit-side lcov consumers

      # CRAP 156 > 12), so they run into shard 0's coverage dir; the gate
      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).
      - name: dart test --tags integration (jsr delegate trio → unit lcov)

{"content":"# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`
  (exit 0; duplication stays a pre-existing soft WARN), loc scope gate (853/853 files within
  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.
  - `test/cli/ansi_markdown_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_table_render_test.dart`,
    `test/config/` — 232 tests passed.
  - `test/cli/tui_chrome_test.dart`, `test/cli/fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_markdown_perf_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for
  `_rollbackGrownTail`), then verified the target methods pass after the split (GREEN: 11.00 /
  5.00, both ≤ 12.00).
- Full `dart test --coverage --exclude-tags integration` (the CI `test-core` unit suite) re-run on
  the final tree: see the job log below; the merged-lcov CRAP measure over it is the same pipeline
  CI's `guards` leg runs.

      # Duration-balanced shards (issue #177 AC3): scripts/test_shards.json
      # maps test FILES to shards (file-level units — test/cli alone was
      # half the suite's runtime and undivisible as a dir-unit); rebalanced
      # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml from junit durations. Bootstrap here
      # is filecount-balanced; the first weekly junit rebalance converges
      # to duration balance. Unknown test files are bin-packed in at
      # runtime by shard_files.py, so a PR adding one never silently skips
      # it. The json file-reporter (converted to junit below — dart test
      # has no built-in junit reporter) feeds the rebalancer real durations
      # (issue #194 AC3).
      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }})
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --coverage=coverage --exclude-tags integration \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py \
            test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json \

      # merge is a union, so one shard carrying them is enough. Keep this
      # list in sync with scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_test_core (gh-1538
      # retired the nightly full-quality copy — the pre-merge gate is the
      # single unit-lcov producer now).

# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`
  (exit 0; duplication stays a pre-existing soft WARN), loc scope gate (853/853 files within
  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.
  - `test/cli/ansi_markdown_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_table_render_test.dart`,
    `test/config/` — 232 tests passed.
  - `test/cli/tui_chrome_test.dart`, `test/cli/fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_markdown_perf_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for
  `_rollbackGrownTail`), then verified the target methods pass after the split (GREEN: 11.00 /
  5.00, both ≤ 12.00).
- Full CI-parity verification on the final tree:
  - `dart test --coverage --exclude-tags integration` (the CI `test-core` unit suite):
    **10566 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**; plus the jsr delegate trio (`--tags integration`,
    45 passed) that feeds the unit lcov in CI.
  - Merged-lcov CRAP measure — the exact pipeline the `guards` leg runs — reports
    **`Max CRAP: 12.00 — OK (threshold: 12.00)`** (was `Max CRAP: 14.00 — FAIL`); the tree max is
    now a pre-existing covered CC-12 dispatcher, with `_rollbackGrownTail` at 11.00 @ 100%.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:

    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.

    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for

# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),

- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`

  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:

    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer

  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads

  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown

    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for

# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`

  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown

    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for

# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`
  (exit 0; duplication stays a pre-existing soft WARN), loc scope gate (853/853 files within
  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.
  - `test/cli/ansi_markdown_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_table_render_test.dart`,
    `test/config/` — 232 tests passed.
  - `test/cli/tui_chrome_test.dart`, `test/cli/fa_tui_boot_output_coalesce_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_markdown_perf_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for
  `_rollbackGrownTail`), then verified the target methods pass after the split (GREEN: 11.00 /
  5.00, both ≤ 12.00).
- Full CI-parity verification on the final tree:
  - `dart test --coverage --exclude-tags integration` (the CI `test-core` unit suite):
    **10566 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**; plus the jsr delegate trio (`--tags integration`,
    45 passed) that feeds the unit lcov in CI.
  - Merged-lcov CRAP measure — the exact pipeline the `guards` leg runs — reports
    **`Max CRAP: 12.00 — OK (threshold: 12.00)`** (was `Max CRAP: 14.00 — FAIL`); the tree max is
    now a pre-existing covered CC-12 dispatcher, with `_rollbackGrownTail` at 11.00 @ 100%.

# gh-1573 rework — CI red head `47e360f2` fixed

## Issues/Notes

- Validation CI on head `47e360f2` had exactly one real root failure; both red jobs trace to it:
  - **CRAP + duplication** (`guards` leg) — step *CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)*:
    `TranscriptMarkdown._rollbackGrownTail` (`lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart:1273`) measured
    **CRAP 14.00 @ 100% coverage (CC 14) — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)**. The gh-1573 fix grew the
    method's guard-clause chain (14 decision points) past the repo's pinned core ratchet.
  - **Quality gate** — failed only as the aggregate of the above (`R_GUARDS: failure` →
    `Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). Every other leg was green.
- No merge conflicts, no open review threads, no review verdict on this PR.

## Approach

- Per the repo ratchet rule (`AGENTS.md`: *"fix the code, then lower the threshold — never lower
  first"*), the threshold stays at 12.0 and the method was brought back under it with a pure
  code-motion refactor — zero behavior change:
  - Extracted the pending-table half of `_rollbackGrownTail` (the gh-1573 seed computation and its
    two refusal guards) into a new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed(List<String> src)` returning a
    Dart record `(bool, List<String>?)`: `(false, _)` refuses the rollback (caller falls back to the
    documented full-rebuild path, exactly as before), `(true, seed)` proceeds — `seed` null when the
    boundary line is table-free. The full doc comment moved with the code.
  - CRAP after the split (100% coverage): `_rollbackGrownTail` **14.00 → 11.00**, new
    `_rollbackTableSeed` **5.00**. Verified RED first on the pre-fix code with the pinned analyzer
    (`crap4dart 0.11.0`, same lcov pipeline as CI: the method row reproduced `14.00 100.0 N/A 14`),
    GREEN after.
- Other failed-job steps re-verified locally on the fixed tree: `crap4dart check --baseline`

  limits, `ansi_markdown.dart` 1737 ≤ 2800), lib/ jscpd duplication 0.79% < 1.0%, cross-module
  `dupx` fast-gate stage OK, `dart analyze` clean. `crap4dart.yaml` threshold untouched
  (the `--only-down` guard forbids raising it).

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/ansi_markdown.dart` — extracted `_rollbackGrownTail`'s pending-table seed/refusal
  block into the new private helper `_rollbackTableSeed`; caller now reads
  `final (rollbackOk, seed) = _rollbackTableSeed(src); if (!rollbackOk) return false;`.
  No public API change; the gh-1573 behavior is byte-identical.

## Test Coverage

- Behavior is covered by the PR's own regression suites, all green on the refactored code:
  - `test/cli/transcript_answer_once_test.dart` — the 4 gh-1573 cases (fence closed in a grown
    tail, rollback, mid-tail service traffic) exercising the seeded rollback this refactor touched.

    `test/config/` — 232 tests passed.

    `test/cli/fa_tui_test.dart`, `test/cli/transcript_markdown_perf_test.dart`,
    `test/cli/resume_perf_503_test.dart` — 148 tests passed.
- CRAP gate: reproduced the CI failure locally (RED: `Max CRAP: 14.00` row for
  `_rollbackGrownTail`), then verified the target methods pass after the split (GREEN: 11.00 /
  5.00, both ≤ 12.00).
- Full CI-parity verification on the final tree:
